visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: 49 Is Listed as a Prime
visualizerParams.problemDescription: 49 is 7 times 7, but the sieve prints it in the list of primes up to 49.

solution.explanation: The last prime whose multiples must be marked is the largest one with p * p <= limit. When p * p equals the limit exactly, as 7 * 7 = 49 does, a strict < skips that prime and its square stays unmarked.
